REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
TUESDAY - SEPTEMBER 9, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

3.

4A.
Selection of Economic Development Commission Chairperson and Vice Chairperson.
Agenda Report
5.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
6.
New and Old Business
6A.
Review and consideration of calendar years 2025 and 2026 Economic Development Commission meeting dates, including a proposed amendment to the regular meeting schedule in November 2025.
Agenda Report
PowerPoint
6B.
Review and consideration of an informational report to the Economic Development Commission regarding the programs and services provided by the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce.
Agenda Report
6C.
Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the roles and responsibilities of the Economic Development Commission.
Agenda Report
PowerPoint
7.
Reports
7A.
Reports from Designated Commission Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
7B.
Reports from Economic Development Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
8.
Adjournment

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Economic Development Commission Meeting
September 9, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703
PRESENT:  Commissioner Kenneth Chiang
  Commissioner Aris Tagle
  Vice Chair Grace Hu
  Chair Alfred Reyes Jr.

PRESENT:  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila
  Theater Executive Director Jeff Thielke
  Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda
  Marketing Administrator Glenn Arnade

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  The Pledgeof Allegiance was led by Director of Community Development Kristin
  Agu iIa.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Economic Development Commission were declared present.

4.  Organization of the EconomicDevelopment Commission
  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila declared the position of Chair of
  the Economic Development Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Chiang nominated Commissioner Reyes for Chair. Commissioner
  Tagle secondedthe nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  MOTION: Commissioner Chiang nominated Commissioner Reyes for Chair.
  Commissioner Tagle seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN :  None

City of Cerritos  September9, 2025
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   Commissioner Reyes was declared Chair of the Economic Development
  Commission.

  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila declared the position of Vice Chair
  of the Economic Development Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Chiang nominated Commissioner Hu for Vice Chair. Chair Reyes
  seconddd the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  MOTION: Commissioner Chiang nominated Commissioner Hu for Vice Chair.
  Chair Reyes seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:
  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioner Hu was declared Vice Chair of the Economic Development
  Commission.

  To allow the Chair and Vice Chair to take their new seats at the dais, a meeting
  recess was called by Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila.

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no one wishing to address the Economic
  Development Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.
6.  New and Old Business
6A.  Review and consideration of calendar years 2025 and 2026 Economic
  Development Commission meeting dates, including a proposed amendment to
  the regular meeting schedule in November 2025.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  PowerPointpresentation was displayed, providing details regarding the Economic
  Development Commission conducting its regular official business meetings on
  the secondTuesday of each month at 7:00 p.m., as establishedby City Council
  Ordinance No. 1049. Discussion followed regarding the potential cancelation or
  rescheduling of the regular Economic Development Commission meeting on
  Tuesday, November 11, 2025, due to the observance of the Veterans Day
  holiday.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes
  declared the public hearing closed.

  MOTION: it was moved by Commissioner Tagle and seconded by Chair Reyesto
  cancelthe November 11, 2025, regular meeting of the EconomicDevelopment
  Commission and schedule a special meeting of the Economic Development
City of Cerritos  September 9, 2025
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page2
   Commission on November 12, 2025.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:
  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6B.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the Economic
  Development Commission regarding the programs and services provided by the
  Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce.

  A brief introduction was given by EconomicDevelopmentManagerKiana
  Miranda.A verbal report was given by Cerritos RegionalChamberof Commerce
  Board Chair Fas and Board Member Lumba. The presentation provided an
  overview of the Chamber’s programs and services designed to support local
  businesses. Mr. Fas answered questions regarding the City of Cerritos’
  membership status with the Chamber of Commerce.

6C.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the roles and
  responsibilities of the Economic Development Commission.

  A staff report was given by EconomicDevelopmentManagerKiana Miranda.A
  PowerPointpresentation was displayed, providing introductory information to the
  Commissionregarding the roles and responsibilitiesof the Commission.
  Discussion followed regarding clarification of an Economic Development Strategic
  Plan and whether it is separate from the City's Strategic Plan.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes
  declared the public hearing closed.

711  Reports
7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Ms. Aguila corrected a statement made during roll call. Ms. Aguila noted a fifth
  appointment was made at the September 8, 2025 8 City Council meeting and the
  Commissioner is anticipated to begin service at the October Economic Development
  Commission regular meeting. Ms. Aguila concluded by expressing the City’s
  readiness to support the Economic Development Commission.

7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Chiang, Commissioner Tagle, Vice Chair Hu,
  and Chair Reyes.
8.  Adjournment
  The meeting adjourned at 7: 58 p.m.
